meta.title: RFQ: lower both lines (90 and 45)
gaps: Guaranteeing that the selected existing event is a live RFQ with exactly two lines whose current prices are 100 and 50
Entering distinct revised prices of 90 on one line and 45 on the other in the vendor portal's bid sheet
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Guaranteeing that the selected existing event is a live RFQ with exactly two lines whose current prices are 100 and 50; Entering distinct revised prices of 90 on one line and 45 on the other in the vendor portal's bid sheet

steps.note: Open an existing event with bids, as the case requires an already-live event rather than creating a new one.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round and its bid form in the vendor portal.
Submit a revised bid from the same vendor; this is the catalog's supported revision action, though it applies one price to every price cell.
Verify that the vendor portal accepted the revision and marked the bid as submitted.
